Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study employs a three-tiered hybrid approach: bottom-up, top-down, and native MS. While the bottom-up portion follows a standard DDA LFQ (iBAQ) workflow, the top-down and native MS portions are specialized for proteoform and complex stoichiometry analysis. No specific enrichment antibodies (like phospho or ubiquitin) were used; instead, the 'enrichment' is the purification of the ribosomal complexes themselves. PTMs of interest include cysteine methylation, dimethylation, and N-terminal acetylation.

scope: we investigate ribosomes, large ribonucleoprotein particles consisting of a multitude of protein and RNA subunits

we demonstrate how this three-tiered MS approach can provide in-depth characterization of four distinct ribosomal particles: E. coli cytosolic 70S ribosomes (Ec70S), chloroplastic 70S ribosomes from spinach (So70S), and human cytosolic 40S (Hs40S) and 60S (Hs60S) ribosomal subunits
Ribosomal purifications of spinach 70S ribosome and human 40S and 60S ribosomal subunits were analyzed with bottom-up LC-MS/MS to identify proteins comprising purified complexes
